steps.npc: Don't bother me, can't you see I'm busy?

steps.player: No, I can't... can I go into the factory?

steps.npc: You can go in. The Consortium, in their infinite wisdom, has decided to open up the factory to all and sundry.
We've built a new blast furnace and always have a shortage of people to work on it.
Just don't go causing any trouble, I still run this factory!
